conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a potential ~1.5%/month return. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5%/month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing new, high-quality long setups. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, balancing growth with risk management.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4%/month by leaning into leverage and concentration. It significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this strategy can lead to substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to zero, eliminating leveraged ETFs.

income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1%/month. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and cutting high-beta names. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
